title: External CI-9 validators would red every PR
context: ci.yml runs 'claude plugin validate' and 'skills-ref validate' on every pull_request, but neither tool is provisioned on a stock GitHub runner: claude CLI is not installed (and needs auth), and skills-ref's install is an unpinned echo-TODO placeholder. Both steps fail command-not-found and turn every PR permanently red, eroding trust in the real green gates (authoring tests, CI-3/6/10, deterministic build, coverage). release.yml already guards its publish behind vars.ENABLE_RELEASE.

options.label: Guard both validator steps behind a repo variable (e.g. ENABLE_PLUGIN_VALIDATORS); they run once install+auth are provisioned in CI, so the PR gate stays genuinely green now
Keep the steps unconditional but mark continue-on-error so a missing tool warns instead of failing
Leave them failing until the installs are pinned (PR gate red on every PR)

rationale: Guard both CI-9 validators behind vars.ENABLE_PLUGIN_VALIDATORS so the PR gate's real checks stay green until install+auth are provisioned in CI (mirrors release.yml ENABLE_RELEASE)
